description: Canonical tool registry for the Cici instance. Defines which tools the Telegram bot may use, their endpoints, key env vars, and the trust tier of their output.

mcp_tools.description: OB1 MCP tools served by the Supabase Edge Function. Endpoint and key read from environment.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Store a thought in Supabase with auto-embedding. Output trust: N/A (write-only).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic vector search across all captured thoughts. Output trust: Tier C.

tools.name: recent_thoughts
tools.description: Retrieve most recently captured thoughts in chronological order. Output trust: Tier C.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Count of total thoughts, date range, tag distribution. Output trust: Tier C.

external_tools.description: External data integrations. All Tier C unless marked. Full source policies in realtime-data surface.
